georgebell.note: Weekly public skating is listed on Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays.
georgebell.quote: We host weekly FREE public skating:

mccormick.note: The page says its schedule ended on April 30, 2026; no new schedule is posted.

northtoronto.quote: Public Skating on the Eglinton Park Outdoor Rink is closed for the season.

harbourfront.note: The rink is not open yet: the page says it will open later.
harbourfront.quote: The Rink will open for the season when cooler weather permits. Keep an eye on this page and we’ll let you know!

bentway.note: The skate trail opens on December 12, 2026 and runs to February 28, 2027.
bentway.quote: From December 12, 2026 through February 28, 2027, lace up and cruise The Bentway’s 220m figure-eight trail.

evergreen.note: Public skating has not started: 3 skating dates are listed, from December 20, 2026 to February 12, 2027 (36 more could not be used).
evergreen.quote: Our public skating will reopen December 19, weather permitting.

mattamy.note: 4 community skates are listed; the next is on December 26, 2026.

fordperformance.note: Read from its November 2026 calendar picture.

mississauga-square.note: The rink is closed for the season and the page says it will reopen.
mississauga-square.quote: Celebration Square’s ice rink is currently closed and will reopen by winter 2026 (weather-dependant).

brampton-outdoor.note: 1 of 16 outdoor rinks is listed as open: Gore Meadows Covered Outdoor Skating Rink (page last updated 11/18/2026 at 1 PM).
brampton-outdoor.quote: Outdoor skating rinks are opening for the season soon! Check operational status below before visiting.
